name: Keturah Pringle

events.title: Second marriage
events.description: Married Philip Manhart (1823-1910) as his/her second marriage.

bioAdditions: FamilySearch tree K86Y-ZB8 gives Keturah's birth as 7 Oct 1835. (The tree misplaces Plymouth in Philadelphia Co.; it is Plymouth, Luzerne Co.) Her first husband was Charles Carter Robbins (1829-1878, d. Hanover Twp. 23 Sep 1878). Their children: Emily (b. 17 Sep 1855, d. 1930), Ella (b. 21 Jun 1859, d. 1919), Lulu M. (b. Nanticoke 20 Aug 1862, d. 1950; she married Charles W. Honeywell), Byron S. (b. 11 Sep 1870, d. 1951) and Clarence Howard (b. 25 Aug 1873, d. 1959). On 19 Sep 1883 she married Philip Manhart (1823-1910). He is evidently the 'Philip Minchart, 26, carpenter' who lived in her mother's house in 1850. She died at Plymouth on 15 Aug 1900 and was buried in Hanover Twp. on 17 Aug 1900. Find a Grave indexes her as 'Robbins Manhart' (S1). The 1880 census entry is indexed as 'Toura Robbins'.

confidenceRecommendation.justification: 1850 census and an FS tree with the 1880 census and Find a Grave; Lulu's marriage to Honeywell matches the site.
